## Plan → landed

| planned | landed |
|---|---|
| relevance from `matched_keyword` + products/CPV/NAICS | `policy/procurement_relevance.py` — `classify_notice` reads `matched_keyword` (the extraction-time reviewed-term match of record) plus `products`/`cpv_code`/`naics`/`psc_code`/`product_or_service_code` against the reviewed vocabulary loaded **as data** from the connectors' committed TOMLs (`tomllib`, sha256-bound — the `exports.jurisdictions` posture; `connectors` is not a policy dependency) |
| unclassified excluded from surveillance surfaces (D-K2-5) | `surveillance_related`/`not_classified` is the closed verdict vocabulary; `not_classified` is typed ("no reviewed signal found", never "not surveillance" — K2 NEW-7); `web/procurement_relevance.json` is the ONE artifact every surveillance surface filters through (`surveillanceNotices` in the TS mirror) |
| buyer-page row label (K2 H-13) | `UNCLASSIFIED_LABEL = "not classified as surveillance-related"` verbatim, one string in both mirrors; `buyerNoticeRows`/`noticeRowLabel` carry the buyer-page listing semantics |
| fail-closed posture | a code no reviewed set names, a term the vocabulary does not carry, a subject outside `procurement_notice:`/`notice:`, and a claim-less notice all land on `not_classified`; code matches are exact-only (no hierarchical-prefix guess); literal scans are word-boundary compiled |
| the export artifact | `spine_export.notice_relevance_facts` (every current publishable input-claim value on the notice families, keyed through `entity_identifier`) + `web/procurement_relevance.json` — schema, publication binding, vocabulary evidence (sources/versions/sha256/counts), per-notice rows, SIG licence, web compartment, manifest counts; a withheld entity emits no row (the label artifact's posture) |
| `procurement_notice:` kind | joins `labels.py` `_KIND_PREFIXES` as the K2 "procurement notice" kind (`notice`) — the prefix `connectors/procurement.py` mints (`procurement_notice:<source>:<tenant>:<id>`) |
